AppConfig.//AuthMethod: One of: ConnectionString, DefaultAzureCredential, SystemAssignedManagedIdentity, UserAssignedManagedIdentity, ServicePrincipalSecret, ServicePrincipalCertificate, AzureCli, WorkloadIdentity
AppConfig.//Endpoint: Set after running Terraform, e.g. https://appconfig-demo-xxxx.azconfig.io. Leave blank to run in local-only mode.
AppConfig.//ConnectionString: Only used when AuthMethod = ConnectionString. Prefer user-secrets / env vars over committing this.
AppConfig.//ManagedIdentityClientId: Client id of a user-assigned managed identity (UserAssignedManagedIdentity, or to pin DefaultAzureCredential).
